sha256-fd-v1:ed4dc3f7c4b75b2bc911c37b789.description: Hunt Gorgus, the man who killed your father, across towns and monster-filled dungeons. This top-down RPG uses turn-based battles, equipment, and side quests to build the hero's strength.
sha256-fd-v1:ed4dc3f7c4b75b2bc911c37b789.title: Mad Paradox

sha256-fd-v1:edce98fb56b6826ce186b1324c9.description: Detective Shinobu Aiba infiltrates a prestigious private school to investigate a series of disappearances. Advance this 1991 Orange House mystery by choosing commands and following clues around campus.
sha256-fd-v1:edce98fb56b6826ce186b1324c9.title: Strush

sha256-hdi-v1:ed6d10c5028ac6f7ba9cb73f67.description: Apprentice magician Marble accidentally releases a demon with her master's Wand of Wishes. Cross single-screen puzzle stages with help from the wand's spirit, Sirius, to repair the damage.
sha256-hdi-v1:ed6d10c5028ac6f7ba9cb73f67.title: Marble Cooking
